title: Doing it fully, to the end

blocks.text: Doing it fully, to the end
вы- — fullness, exhaustion, the limit of an action
«полноты, исчерпанности, предела действия» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of вы-. Its examples: выполнить, выяснить, выговориться.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to carry out, to implement, to accomplish, to fulfill, to execute, to perform; to make up, to create
to clear up, to elucidate, to clarify, to find out, to ascertain

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «вы-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/вы-).
о- — the limit, completeness, result of an action
«предела, завершённости, результативности действия» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of о-. Its examples: остругать, ослабеть, овдоветь, ослепнуть, оглохнуть.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to weaken, to become weaker, to become/grow weak; to slacken, to relax, to ease, to abate, to subside
to become/go blind, to lose one's sight

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).
от- — thoroughness, completeness
«тщательности, завершённости» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of от-. Its examples: отделать, отутюжить.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to finish, to trim (up); to trim (with)

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).
про- — completeness, exhaustion or thoroughness of an action
«законченности, исчерпанности или тщательности действия» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of про-. Its examples: проштудировать, проговорить, пропесочить.

head: Word

Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to say, to utter; to talk (for a while)

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).
с- — the limit, the result of the action itself
«собственно предела, результативности действия» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of с-. Its examples: спеть, смилостивиться.
Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 8 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).
у- — completing the action of the base verb, bringing it to a result or to exhaustive fullness

«выражает завершение (доведение до результата, до исчерпывающей полноты) действия, названного мотивирующим глаголом» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of у-. Its examples: укомплектовать, убаюкать, ужалить, урегулировать, усовершенствовать, устыдить, утаить.

to enhance, to upgrade, to improve, to refine
to conceal, to keep to oneself, to keep a secret; to steal, to appropriate

по- — completing an action, covering its object fully or in part
The Russian Wiktionary's examples for this meaning of по-: позавтракать, покрасить, подвинуть.

head: Word

Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to have breakfast, to breakfast, to lunch

под- —

(used with verbs) (describing a meaning that shows a finished action or an obtainment of a result) — под- + писа́ть (“to write”) → подписа́ть (“to sign, to subscribe (in the sense of writing one's name with a result)”)

head: Word

Meaning (Wiktionary)

blocks.text: Wiktionary, «под-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/под-#Russian).
на- — to repletion, to satiation, to the full, enough, too much
(with verbs) to repletion, to satiation, to the full, enough, too much — на- + пить (“to drink”) + -ся → напи́ться (“to drink to the full; to quench one’s thirst; to get drunk”)

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to quench thirst; to get drunk

blocks.text: Wiktionary, «на-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/на-#Russian).
за- — describing an intensified or extreme action or an action of doing something up to the point that an object becomes junk

(used with verbs) describing an intensified or extreme action or an action of doing something up to the point that an object becomes junk — за- + чита́ть (“to read”) → зачита́ть (“to read (a book, as well as not returning it back; until it becomes all torn apart; simply reading out loud, denoting that the loud voice is a sign of intensified or extreme action)”); за- + сиде́ть (“to sit”) → засиде́ться (“to sit down, to stay for quite a long time (denoting that the long duration of sitting is a sign of intensified or extreme action)”); за- + ду́мать (“to think”) → заду́мать (“to devise”)
Wiktionary, «за-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/за-#Russian).
из- — fullness, abundance, exhaustion
«полноты, обилия, исчерпанности» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of из-. Its examples: изрезать, изукрасить, изрешетить, измучиться.
Russian Wiktionary, «из-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-).
пре- — fullness or high intensity of an action
«полноты или высокой интенсивности действия» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of пре-. Its examples: пресытить, преувеличить.
Russian Wiktionary, «пре-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/пре-).
в- — thoroughness, fullness of an action
«основательности, полноты действия» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of в-. Its examples: вчитаться, вчитываться, вписаться, вписываться, всмотреться, всматриваться.
